item.title: Holy shit holy shit holy shit holy shit: The magnitude of what’s now happening
item.description: I feel like my previous posts (and post titles), and podcasts, and talks, have failed to do full justice to the magnitude of what's now happening, so I'm trying again. Last night, we had friends and colleagues over for dinner. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)
